description: Today U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren endorsed Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell’s campaign for re-election, highlighting Campbell’s proven leadership in making life more affordable for families, standing up to corporate abuse, and defending Massachusetts from attacks on its values and economy.

title: Senator Elizabeth Warren Endorses Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for Re-Election - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
